name: Trailer Reel
description: Maintains a local catalog of recent and upcoming movie trailers and plays same-genre trailers before movies.
overview: Recent and upcoming same-genre movie trailers as Jellyfin prerolls.

versions.changelog:
Adds a dedicated anime-movie trailer pool for Jellyfin 12.1.

- Uses the anime pool only when a movie from the configured Anime Movies library is played.
- Keeps a separate default cap of 30 anime trailers alongside the regular 100-trailer pool.
- Discovers anime candidates with TMDb Animation, Japanese original-language, and Japan-origin filters.
- Continues excluding movies already hosted in Jellyfin.
- Preserves per-user watched-trailer history so each profile avoids repeats.
- Migrates existing catalogs into the regular pool without discarding watched state.

name: Theme Music Finder
description: Scans TV series, checks Plex by TVDB ID, falls back to ThemerrDB by TMDB ID, and saves validated theme.mp3 files without overwriting existing themes.
overview: Finds missing TV series theme music and saves it as theme.mp3.

versions.changelog:
## What changed

- Changed provider priority to ThemerrDB first, strict AnimeThemes second, and Plex last.
- Added exact title/synonym and year validation for AnimeThemes OP1 audio.
- Blocked Plex's known incorrect **Barber of Seville** mapping for *A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms*.
- Added configurable EBU R128 normalization for new downloads, defaulting to -18 LUFS and -1.5 dBTP.
- Added provider, catalogue ID, and source URL audit logging.
- Existing **theme.mp3** files are never overwritten.

Targets Jellyfin 12.1.
Jellyfin 12.1 release with ThemerrDB fallback when no Plex theme is found.
